description: This file defines the main navigation components for an admin UI, including navigation list, items, footer, and developer resources menu, using React and Keystone UI components.

methods.name: getHrefFromList
methods.description: Generates a URL path string from a list metadata object, appending '/1' if the list is a singleton.

methods.name: NavItem
methods.description: Component representing a navigation item that adjusts aria-current based on route matching.

methods.name: NavList
methods.description: Wrapper component for navigation list with specific accessibility and styling props.

methods.name: NavContainer
methods.description: Root container for the navigation, providing vertical stacking and spacing.

methods.name: Navigation
methods.description: Main navigation component that renders navigation links or a custom component if provided in config.

methods.name: NavFooter
methods.description: Component for rendering a footer section in navigation, used to hold secondary items.

methods.name: DeveloperResourcesMenu
methods.description: Component providing a menu of developer resources, conditionally rendering based on environment and environment variables.
